column2: # Summarize the data: calculate average quality of sleep
sleep_summary <- aggregate(data$`Quality of Sleep`, by = list(data$Occupation), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
# Sort the data for better visualization
ggplot(sleep_summary, aes(x = reorder(Occupation, -Avg_Quality_Sleep), y = Avg_Quality_Sleep, fill = Occupation)) +
title = "Average Quality of Sleep by Occupation",
